decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The application for the erection of a conservatory to the side/rear of the existing house, as shown on drawings numbered C9174-1, C9174-2 and 'Proposed Amgeda Conservatory for Mrs Thomson', received 3rd November 2006, is recommended for approval as the size, position and style of the conservatory would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing building, the amenity of neighbouring properties or would detract from the character of the Conservation Area. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of a conservatory to the side/rear of the existing house
